title: vtc-00: forbidden leaks block status
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:623 returns forbidden when all ring targets blocked the caller, revealing the block for 1:1 rings; contradicts :1329 'initiator is not informed'. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:867 returns forbidden when the initiator blocked the joiner. Fix: all-blocked ring proceeds silently and times out; blocked join returns the same notFound as an inaccessible call.
close_reason: All-blocked ring now proceeds and times out; blocked joiner gets notFound like an inaccessible call. Residual: in a chat-bound call the blocked joiner can still VTCCall/get it, so notFound differs from what get shows.
